patch.summary: OpenPhone cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: OpenPhone pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 7-day trial documented.

scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Phone menus, automatic recording and deeper CRM require Business or above

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: No power dialer; fair-use policy prohibits cold calling and auto-dialers

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: No native WhatsApp Business or video meetings product

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Sona AI overage credits and extra numbers raise real TCO beyond seat floors
